_note: Augment pairs that feed each other, from confirmed mechanics (data/cook-builds/MECHANICS.md, the augments' own text, the League wiki). augment_synergy.py always simulates a pair here when the Simulator models both augments; otherwise `points` (win-rate points, 2 strong, 1 some, negative when they clash) is used as is. Order-dependent pairs give `a_first` (a taken before b) and `b_first` instead of `points`; they are never simulated. Keys are simulator/data/augments.json keys. Add a pair only with a source.
